en.title: Moral Torture Machine
en.short_description: Moral Torture Machine: Generate ethical dilemmas, choose, and compare decisions.
en.full_description: Moral Torture Machine is an interactive app that generates ethical dilemmas, challenging your decision-making skills. Choose between two options, see teasing outcomes, and compare your choice with others through a visual distribution bar. With a sleek, modern design, it supports light and dark modes for a personalized experience. Perfect for sparking discussions or exploring moral questions, this app blends fun and introspection seamlessly.
